entries.title: Syrava Factory
entries.text: Syrava Factory is the customer-facing catalog and composition layer for Syrava's automation portfolio. It provides the website, customer-facing catalog, deployment boundaries, and integration contracts while the runtime repositories remain authoritative.

entries.title: Factory portfolio
entries.text: Factory presents 300 workflows and 50 analytical agents, for 350 currently cataloged assets, plus a 500-asset expansion blueprint consisting of 400 planned workflows and 100 planned agents.

entries.title: Open-source voice
entries.text: Factory's free-first voice adapters include faster-whisper and whisper.cpp for speech-to-text, and Piper and Kokoro for text-to-speech. Paid providers are optional fallbacks rather than default dependencies.

entries.title: Deployment governance
entries.text: Factory requires customer authorization for private systems, supports schema and field discovery with confidence scoring and read-only acceptance tests, and uses fail-closed approval boundaries so high-governance systems cannot make consequential final decisions or act without qualified approval.

entries.title: Guided product tours
entries.text: Factory product tours are illustrative records that demonstrate deployment behavior through problem, evidence, approval, and handoff stages without pretending the site is connected to a customer's systems or claiming a financial return.
